title: Strict scalar/pullback square on quotient towers
statement: For the scalar extension and pullback strict quotient functors attached to a morphism f:X→Y, the normalized left and right chain isomorphisms agree on the whole quotient tower.

source.place: Tags 03EL and 07A4, homogeneous generator calculation in the strict quotient systems.

proof.text: Apply extensionality degreewise and on pro-etale sections. The scalar adjunction transpose reduces the claim to homogeneous tensor generators. The scalar and pullback section formulas, together with the normalized tensor and pullback comparison formulas, send every generator to the same associated tensor; naturality retains all quotient transitions.

from.place: strict part of the original proof step

lean.statement:
theorem scalarTowerPullbackStrictSquare {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    leftRoute l E L ι f = rightRoute l E L ι f
